## Keybinds

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="30%"}

### niri

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `Super+Return` | Terminal (kitty) |
| `Super+Q` | Close window |
| `Super+Space` | Launcher |
| `Super+B` | Browser (zen) |
| `Super+E` | Files (dolphin) |
| `Super+Tab` | Overview |
| `Super+H/J/K/L` | Focus column/window |
| `Super+F` | Maximize column |
| `Super+Shift+F` | Fullscreen |
| `Super+T` | Toggle tabbed column |
| `Super+V` | Toggle floating |
| `Super+R` | Cycle preset column widths |
| `Super+Ctrl+1-4` | Set column width 100/50/33/25% |
| `Super+-` / `Super+=` | Shrink / grow column |
| `Super+,` / `Super+.` | Consume / expel window from column |
| `Super+1-9` | Switch workspace |
| `Super+Shift+1-9` | Move window to workspace |
| `Super+Ctrl+Left/Right` | Previous / next workspace |
| `Super+Shift+S` | Screenshot (region) |
| `Print` | Screenshot (screen) |
| `Super+Shift+L` | Lock screen |
| `Super+X` | Session menu |

:::

:::

### nvim (LazyVim)

Leader: `Space`

#### Files & search
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `leader ff` | Find files |
| `leader fg` | Live grep |
| `leader fb` | Buffers |
| `leader fr` | Recent files |
| `leader e` | File explorer (oil) |
| `leader /` | Grep in current buffer |

#### LSP
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `gd` | Go to definition |
| `gr` | Go to references |
| `gI` | Go to implementation |
| `K` | Hover docs |
| `leader ca` | Code action |
| `leader cr` | Rename symbol |
| `leader cd` | Show diagnostic |
| `[d` / `]d` | Previous / next diagnostic |

#### Git
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `leader gg` | Lazygit |
| `leader gb` | Git blame line |
| `leader gd` | Git diff |
| `]h` / `[h` | Next / previous hunk |
| `leader gh` | Preview hunk |

#### Editing
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `gc` | Comment (motion) |
| `gcc` | Comment line |
| `leader cf` | Format |
| `sa` | Add surrounding |
| `sd` | Delete surrounding |
| `sr` | Replace surrounding |

#### Command history
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `q:` | Open command-line window (normal mode) |
| `C-f` | Open command-line window (while in `:`) |

#### Buffers & windows
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `leader bd` | Close buffer |
| `[b` / `]b` | Previous / next buffer |
| `C-h/j/k/l` | Navigate splits / tmux panes |
| `leader wv` / `leader ws` | Split vertical / horizontal |
| `leader wd` | Close window |

:::

::: {.column width="5%"}
:::

::: {.column width="30%"}

### tmux

Prefix: `C-a`

#### Panes
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `C-h/j/k/l` | Navigate panes (passes through to nvim splits) |
| `prefix \|` | Split horizontal |
| `prefix -` | Split vertical |
| `prefix z` | Zoom pane fullscreen / unzoom |
| `prefix {` / `}` | Swap pane positions |
| `prefix Space` | Cycle pane layouts |
| `prefix !` | Break pane into its own window |
| `prefix H/J/K/L` | Resize pane |
| `M-arrow` | Navigate panes (no prefix) |

#### Windows
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `prefix c` | New window (in current path) |
| `S-left/right` | Previous / next window |

#### Sessions
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `prefix s` | Interactive session switcher |
| `prefix $` | Rename session |
| `prefix C-s` | Save session (tmux-resurrect) |
| `prefix C-r` | Restore session (tmux-resurrect) |

#### Copy mode
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `prefix [` | Enter copy mode |
| `v` | Begin selection |
| `y` | Copy selection |
| `/` | Search |
| `n` / `N` | Next / previous match |

#### Misc
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `prefix r` | Reload config |
| `prefix C-l` | Clear terminal |
| `prefix I` | Install plugins (TPM) |

:::

## Tools

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="45%"}

### Quarto

```bash
# Render to HTML
quarto render file.qmd

# Render to PDF
quarto render file.qmd --to pdf

# Live preview with hot reload
quarto preview file.qmd

# Render this cheatsheet
cd ~/dotfiles && quarto render cheatsheet.qmd
```

### GNU Stow

```bash
# Stow a package (create symlinks)
stow zsh

# Stow multiple packages
stow zsh git nvim

# Stow everything
stow */

# Remove symlinks
stow -D zsh

# Restow (after editing)
stow -R zsh
```

### Docker

```bash
# List containers (custom alias)
dps

# Start / stop container
docker start <name>
docker stop <name>

# Exec into running container
docker exec -it <name> bash

# Follow logs
docker logs -f <name>

# Remove stopped containers
docker container prune
```

:::

::: {.column width="10%"}
:::

::: {.column width="45%"}

### ffmpeg

```bash
# Convert video format
ffmpeg -i input.mp4 output.mkv

# Re-encode with H.265 (smaller file)
ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -c:v libx265 -crf 28 output.mp4

# Extract audio
ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vn -c:a copy output.aac

# Trim (from 00:01:00, duration 30s)
ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -ss 00:01:00 -t 30 -c copy output.mp4

# Scale to 1080p
ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf scale=-1:1080 output.mp4

# Convert images to video (30fps)
ffmpeg -framerate 30 -pattern_type glob -i '*.png' -c:v libx264 output.mp4

# Screen record (Wayland)
ffmpeg -f pipewire -i default output.mp4
```

### WSL (access from Linux)

WSL2 stores its Linux filesystem inside a VHDX virtual hard disk image on your Windows drive.

```bash
# Find the VHDX file on your mounted Windows partition
find /mnt/windows/Users/*/AppData/Local/Packages/*buntu*/LocalState \
  -name "ext4.vhdx" 2>/dev/null

# Load the network block device kernel module
sudo modprobe nbd

# Connect the VHDX to a block device
sudo qemu-nbd -c /dev/nbd0 /path/to/ext4.vhdx

# Mount it
sudo mkdir -p /mnt/wsl_rootfs
sudo mount /dev/nbd0 /mnt/wsl_rootfs

# Browse your WSL home folder
ls /mnt/wsl_rootfs/home/<username>/

# When done: unmount and disconnect
sudo umount /mnt/wsl_rootfs
sudo qemu-nbd -d /dev/nbd0
```

Requires: `qemu-img` (`sudo pacman -S qemu-img`)

### git

```bash
# Amend last commit message
git commit --amend -m "new message"

# Undo last commit, keep changes staged
git reset --soft HEAD~1

# Stash with message
git stash push -m "description"

# Apply specific stash
git stash apply stash@{2}

# Interactive rebase (last N commits)
git rebase -i HEAD~3

# Show file at specific commit
git show <hash>:path/to/file

# Find commit that introduced a bug
git bisect start
git bisect bad         # current is broken
git bisect good <hash> # known good commit
```
